Swift Concurrency
Trend

Health Check

Trend gives shared data clear owners and coordinates its main workflows using Swift Concurrency. Some CFA boundaries and snapshot types need attention.

✓
Assessment
Good foundation
Clear state ownership and deliberate task coordination, with CFA boundaries to refine.

What is working well

✓

Weight and habit writes are coordinated

Features serialize updates and publish confirmed data after their storage operations complete.

Evidence: WeightLogFeature.swift:28–40, 109–118; HabitsFeature.swift:136–147, 158–178.

✓

Progress avoids obsolete calculations

The progress tracker cancels superseded work and checks cancellation before publishing.

Evidence: ProgressTracker.swift:19–56.

✓

Purchase and backup work have owners

Purchase refreshes share a retained task; backup requests are coalesced and a pre-restore copy is saved before replacement.

Evidence: PurchaseFeature.swift:46–56; BackupFeature.swift:72–110; LocalDataStore.swift:101–117.

Worth a closer look

!

Several Features depend on another Feature

WeightEntryFeature, ProgressFeature, SettingsFeature and WeightImportFeature receive the shared WeightLogFeature. This departs from the agreed CFA preference for independent Features; it does not itself demonstrate a concurrency failure.

Evidence: AppModel.swift:72–105.

!

Weight snapshots have mutable properties

WeightEntry exposes date, kilograms and note as mutable properties. The current CFA guidance calls for immutable published snapshots; editable drafts can remain mutable.

Evidence: WeightEntry.swift:5–8; WeightLogFeature.swift:59–64.

How the app’s work flows

Start the app and initialise Features

Path: UIKit delegate → AppModel → feature observers and independent loads

Task ownership: AppModel starts initial unstructured tasks; Features retain shared work and observers

Isolation: MainActor coordination and actor-isolated services

The delegate signals the model directly; the model starts independent tasks without blocking the first screen.

Record, edit and delete weight

Path: Weight screens → weight ViewModels → WeightEntryFeature → WeightLogFeature → local repository

Task ownership: Screen-created tasks and ViewModel-owned editor/deletion tasks

Isolation: MainActor Features; LocalDataStore actor

Weight changes are serialized and published after the repository saves; callers use returned entry IDs.

Load, choose and record habits

Path: Habit screens → screen ViewModels → HabitsFeature → HabitsWorker → local store

Task ownership: Screen tasks; HabitsFeature retains its shared initial load

Isolation: MainActor Feature; HabitsWorker and LocalDataStore actors

The Feature shares its initial load and serializes habit changes; saved values are published when the worker returns.

Purchase and restore Habits

Path: Habits screen → HabitsViewModel → PurchaseFeature → StoreKitPurchaseClient

Task ownership: ViewModel retains interaction; Feature retains transaction observer and refresh

Isolation: MainActor Feature and StoreKit client

Repeated interactions share a ViewModel task, purchase state guards concurrent purchase or restore, and entitlement refreshes use request identity.

Open, preview and import weight history

Path: File picker or open URL → import screen → WeightImportFeature → file reader and WeightLogFeature

Task ownership: SwiftUI owns preview task; button starts an independent import task

Isolation: MainActor presentation and Feature; file reader and storage actors

Preview reads a bounded file and checks cancellation; merge reloads and serializes the durable write.

Back up and restore data

Path: Backup screen → BackupsViewModel → BackupFeature → storage and backup file actors

Task ownership: ViewModel retains accepted action; Feature retains backup and observers

Isolation: MainActor coordination; storage and recovery file actors

Backup requests share a task; restore validates the snapshot and preserves a pre-restore copy before replacement.

Change settings and manage weight data

Path: Settings screen → SettingsViewModel → SettingsFeature → settings store and WeightLogFeature

Task ownership: Screen-created tasks for save, export, delete and framework-owned refresh

Isolation: MainActor settings and Feature; file and storage actors

Settings write local preferences; goal and history mutations go through the serialized weight store.

Calculate and display progress

Path: Progress selection → ProgressFeature → ProgressTracker → ProgressInsights actor

Task ownership: ProgressTracker retains and cancels the previous calculation task

Isolation: MainActor presentation and tracker; ProgressInsights actor

The progress tracker cancels superseded calculations and checks cancellation before publishing a snapshot.

Refresh after foreground and time changes

Path: UIKit lifecycle → AppModel → Feature refresh or day update

Task ownership: AppModel starts independent lifecycle tasks

Isolation: MainActor coordination and Feature state; storage actor

Foreground activity requests weight and habit reloads; the feature operation queues serialize access.

✓

Conclusion

  • ✓Weight and habit changes are serialized and published after storage succeeds.
  • ✓Progress calculations guard against publishing cancelled results.
  • ✓Purchases, backup and import have explicit coordinating owners.
  • ✓Feature dependencies and mutable weight snapshots are opportunities to align with current CFA rules.

Simulator tests were not run during this source review.
